class.name: HTMLHeadingElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML heading element.
class.description: Returned by queries and [method HTMLLayout.create_element] for [code]<h1>[/code] through [code]<h6>[/code]. Use [method get_level] to read its heading level.

method.name: get_level
method.description: Returns the heading level from [code]1[/code] through [code]6[/code], or [code]0[/code] if the handle is invalid.
